notes.title: Revamped & Recharged: Audio Visualizer's Fresh Start!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone!
[/h2]
First off, huge thanks for sticking around during these silent years. Your patience has been nothing short of amazing. 😊

So, here's the scoop: I'm not just updating Powelus's Audio Visualizer – I'm rebuilding it from scratch! The old code was like a wild spaghetti monster, super tricky to tweak without causing a total meltdown. Plus, when I tried updating to the newer Unity engine, some key features went bonkers. Starting fresh seemed like the only sane option.


[h3]Here's what I've been cooking up so far:
[/h3]
Multilanguage support (yay for understanding what's actually going on!)

Steam cloud saving is in! No more messing with registry files. Plus, you can have multiple presets now.

I'm also dabbling with Steam Workshop for user-created presets. Uploading works, but downloading's being a bit stubborn – probably because I've set it to dev testing only. I'm on it, though!

[h3]About the app changes:
[/h3]
I ditched the lights from the visualizer points. They were a performance hog and the new rendering pipeline just gave them the cold shoulder. Now, we've got sleek quads with textures, which is pretty much the same vibe but way easier on your system.

[b]Big dream:[/b] I want the GPU to take over from the CPU for crunching those audio samples. This means we could go way beyond the current 512 samples limit. Still figuring out the GPU magic, but I'm on it!

No ETA on the update yet – don't want to box myself into a deadline and end up rushing things. Quality takes time, right?

For the real-time deets, join the Discord gang ([url=https://discord.gg/Dkb8wfx]https://discord.gg/Dkb8wfx[/url]). It's where all the action happens! Oh, and about the UI – I've seen your comments, and I'm exploring a few designs. I'll definitely be hitting you up for your thoughts on those.

Again, massive thanks for hanging in there. Your support means the world!

Catch you on Discord,
Powelus (Vedran)

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
It's been quite a time (I know), and due to Covid-19, my full-time job has got very busy.
But I hope you are all alright and safe at your homes!

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where radius would get smaller when changing movement speed with BassReact enabled
[*] Added slider for dot size (requested feature)
[*] Added gradient (see below)
[*] Added developer console 
[*] Optimization fixes
[/list]

[h2]Gradient[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401129/c792548e1b12f25285f0c04a6f83d3eda5404b55.gif[/img]



The visualizer now supports two colors. The color will change based on the frequency intensity for each dot. You can also change blending between two colors. As this feature is new there might be some issues.  The development of this took time due to custom shader causing issues, and lots of playtesting to ensure it works properly and doesn't hit performance.


There are more features planned as suggestions keep coming.
Some are more demanding than others, but I'll look into all of them.


Thank you all for helping out and for your support.

Powelus :)

notes.title: Release is very close
notes.content:
After a few delays (I'm very sorry about this) I can confirm that the software will release the 3rd of February 2020.

All the major and minor issues have been fixed. Few new features added such as:
[list]
[*] Hotkeys

[*] Bass react

[*] And a few changes in the UI
[/list]

I would like to thank everybody who participated in the closed beta. Unfortunately, the beta keys will be disabled as of today due to its end. The software will be released with a 20% discount.

The development won't stop upon getting out of early access. Early access is here to guide the development of the software with users' feedback.
